> What sheet????

The rare sheet.

> How many cards on each sheet?????

Some large number. Typically 100. Some sets had 90-card sheets.
Some had 110 card sheets. There may be other arrangements.

The key is that a given R2 is twice as common as a given R1 from
the same set.
